claims.text: Empirically treat all close contacts (household, direct skin-to-skin), even if asymptomatic
claims.quote: Key prevention measures include empiric treatment of all close contacts (eg, household members, those with direct skin-to-skin contact) even if they are asymptomatic.

claims.text: Wash clothing, bedding and linens in hot water (≥ 50 to 54° C) and dry on high heat for 10 minutes, or seal items in a plastic bag for up to 1 week
claims.quote: Decontamination measures are also recommended; clothing, bedding, and linens should be washed in hot water (≥ 50 to 54° C [≥ 122 to 130° F]) and dried on a high-heat cycle for 10 minutes, or contaminated items should be isolated in a sealed plastic bag for up to 1 week ( 3 ).
